push_fastai_model: push a fastai Learner model checkpoint to the Hugging Face Hub with optional config and filtering
load_fastai_model: load a pretrained fastai Learner model from the Hugging Face Hub or a local directory
save_fastai_model: save a fastai Learner to a local directory in pickle format with config and model card
check_fastai_versions: check that installed fastai and fastcore versions are compatible for pickle serialization
check_pyproject_versions: check that pyproject.toml fastai and fastcore versions are compatible with from_pretrained_fastai
